# Matriarch Firmware Fixes

> Unofficial bug fixes for the Moog Matriarch analog synthesizer's firmware v1.3.0, the last release before the Matriarch was discontinued. A free browser tool patches the user's own copy of Moog's firmware file locally, nothing is uploaded. It makes released notes stop when the key is let go in paraphonic mode, so staccato playing works again, and stops HOLD from sending sustain to connected gear while the Arp/Seq is playing. Free software under the GPLv3 or later, by Benjamin Dehli for Dehli Musikk. Not affiliated with Moog Music.

In 2- and 4-note paraphonic mode, firmware v1.3.0 keeps a released note's oscillator sounding for 125 ms while other keys are held. Moog lists it as the known issue "Paraphonic Mixer Gate Length". The patcher shortens that hold to 5 ms (recommended), 50 ms (how firmware v1.1.0 behaved) or any whole number of milliseconds from 0 to 125. The hold also decides whether keys were lifted together, so notes pressed together with a key that's still held keep Moog's 125 ms, and lifted chords ring out with the release as with Moog's firmware.

The HOLD button also works as a sustain pedal when the Arp/Seq isn't running, and firmware v1.3.0 sends sustain (MIDI CC 64) even while the Arp/Seq is running. Moog lists that as the known issue "ARP sends Sustain CC while Hold is active". With the HOLD fix, connected gear sustains exactly when HOLD is on and the Arp/Seq isn't running. The fixes can be applied together or on their own.

## Pages

- [Matriarch Firmware Patcher](https://benjamindehli.github.io/matriarch-firmware-fixes/index.html.md): the patcher, what each fix does and why, the mixer gate hold time in each firmware version, what HOLD sends before and after the fix, Moog's other known issues, and common questions.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/benjamindehli/matriarch-firmware-fixes): the patcher, a command-line version in Python, tests and analysis tools, GPLv3 or later.
- [README](https://github.com/benjamindehli/matriarch-firmware-fixes/blob/main/README.md): how to patch and flash, how the fix works at instruction level, the firmware file format, and hardware notes.
- [Releases](https://github.com/benjamindehli/matriarch-firmware-fixes/releases): release notes for each version.

## Facts

- Supported firmware: Moog Matriarch v1.3.0 only (`Matriarch_Firmware_v1_3_0.syx`). Other versions are refused.
- Fixed: Paraphonic Mixer Gate Length. Notes pressed together keep Moog's 125 ms, so lifted chords ring out with the release.
- Fixed: ARP sends Sustain CC while Hold is active. Tested on hardware with a Yamaha DX7 on MIDI out. Without the patch, pressing and releasing a sustain pedal after engaging HOLD clears the sustain on connected gear.
- Not fixed yet: Send Program Change, Load Default Settings leaving global mode stuck, Sequence Random Repeat, Sequence Keyed Restart, Keyed Timing Reset with Hold, Delay Sync CV Bend stepping.
- The patched firmware isn't distributed, because it's still Moog's copyrighted firmware. Users patch their own copy.
- Flashing uses Moog's normal procedure with a SysEx tool: INVALIDATE, re-select the MIDI port, ERASE, then the patched file. Flashing Moog's original file the same way restores stock firmware.
- The mixer gate fix doesn't touch Multi Trig or the envelope retrigger timing that fixed stuck envelopes. The HOLD fix only changes MIDI output: the Matriarch's own sound, the sustain pedal and incoming MIDI sustain work as before.
